messages:
anya: Quick sync: we need to finalize ownership between control plane and data plane for hosted/dedicated/private, especially for fallbacks and telemetry.

mike: Agreed. Incident showed ambiguity when dedicated spilled to hosted. Main questions: token flow, who annotates telemetry, and secret handling.

sophia: Runtime stance: data plane (edge/runtime) does routing, KV cache, local enforcement, and annotates traces. Control plane publishes manifests, JWKS, and fallback rules.

kevin: We must NOT export tenant master keys to hosted. Current proxy leaks keys. Propose short-lived fallback tokens signed by Dedicated/Private control plane.

rachel: Fallback token sketch: signed JWT with iss=dedicated, aud=redwood-hosted, exp short, and embedded scoped limits. Hosted validates via tenant JWKS.

anya: Good. Tradeoffs: hosted must fetch/verify JWKS and handle revocation. We require a JWKS endpoint + invalidation webhook in manifest.

mike: Telemetry: edge must inject headers: X-Redwood-Tenant, X-Redwood-Trace, X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason before forwarding. Hosted consumes them for billing/traces.

sophia: Config translation: manifest may include a tiny DSL for deterministic field mapping (rename/clamp/immutable). Keep DSL minimal and audited.

kevin: Decision proposal: 1) Data plane owns routing/cache/annotation/enforcement. 2) Control plane owns manifests, JWKS, fallback rules, translation DSL. 3) Cross-host fallbacks use short-lived signed tokens; no master key export. 4) Hosted caches JWKS with short TTL and supports invalidation webhook. 5) Manifest includes header contract and DSL snippet.

rachel: Ops: add runbook for JWKS cache TTL, alerts on JWKS fetch failures, and fallback audit events.

sophia: I'll draft a short RFC (DSL sketch + token format + sequence diagram).

kevin: I'll add revocation semantics and webhook examples.

deploy-bot: deploy:infra-notes: RFC created /rfc/edge-fallback-tokens (link) :white_check_mark:

anya: Thanks. DECISION: lock the above split and require signed fallback tokens + JWKS discovery/invalidation for Dedicated/Private -> Hosted fallbacks.
